items.explanation: Nikt needs nie before the verb: Nikt nie przyszedł.
optionNotes: A copy of the English single negation; Polish needs nie too.
Nie goes before the verb, not before nikt.

items.explanation: How someone does something: the adverb dobrze (well).
optionNotes: An adjective (good); a verb needs the adverb.
An adjective (good); a verb needs the adverb.

items.explanation: Nigdy needs nie, and after nie the object is in the genitive: kawy.
optionNotes: Nigdy needs nie before the verb.
After nie the object takes the genitive: kawy.
A copy of "always don't"; "never" is nigdy nie.

items.explanation: Agreeing with a negative: Ja też nie.
optionNotes: Ja też means "me too", agreeing with a positive.
